nodes.clause_description: Designate a liaison officer with NCA for cybersecurity risk management activation
Inventory and classify all organization assets (sensitive systems, OT, social media accounts, etc.) per NCA guidance, and review classification periodically
Inventory internet-facing assets
Report identified assets (from 5.2 and 5.3) to NCA periodically via Haseen platform, and update upon any change

Report cybersecurity risks at catastrophic (level 5) and high (level 4) levels to NCA immediately upon identification, per the risk assessment matrix (Figure 2), and share treatment plans periodically
Address risks, vulnerabilities, and observations received from NCA; report on remediation actions periodically via Haseen platform
Develop and operate a continuous program for cybersecurity risk management methodology with dedicated resources
Engage stakeholders in various phases (e.g., cybersecurity supervisory committee, IT department)
Inventory and classify organization assets
Inventory cybersecurity vulnerabilities
Inventory potential cybersecurity threats
Develop expected cybersecurity risk scenarios based on threats and vulnerabilities
Identify currently applied controls to address expected risk scenarios
Determine acceptable risk level for the organization
Conduct inherent risk analysis for all expected risk scenarios and currently applied controls, assessing likelihood and impact per the risk assessment matrix (Figure 2)
Document analysis and assessment results in the cybersecurity risk register
Develop cybersecurity risk treatment plans
Assess expected residual risk after executing treatment plans to confirm acceptable risk level is reached
Make risk treatment decision (accepting, sharing, mitigating, or avoiding) and define related treatment plans
Prioritize treatment plans
Execute treatment plans
Update cybersecurity risk register to include treatment plans and residual risks
Develop cybersecurity risk management reports
Establish statistical data collection criteria for risk monitoring
Monitor treatment plan execution periodically and issue related reports

Re-execute risk management methodology periodically, or per NCA guidance, or upon change in: treatment plans, potential threats, expected scenarios, control implementation status, or digital infrastructure
